title: Creamy Edamame and Basil Soup with Whole-Grain Toast
intro: Velvety and vibrant, this bright green soup transforms convenient freezer staples into a deeply savory, herb-forward bowl.

ingredients.name: low-sodium vegetable broth
ingredients.canonical_name: Soup, vegetable broth, low sodium, canned

ingredients.name: unsalted pumpkin seeds (pepitas)
ingredients.canonical_name: Seeds, pumpkin and squash seed kernels, dried

instructions: Heat the extra-virgin olive oil in a medium pot over medium heat until shimmering. Add the garlic and cook for 1 to 2 minutes until fragrant and softened. Check at 1 minute.

Add the frozen shelled edamame and low-sodium vegetable broth. Bring to a rolling boil over medium-high heat, then reduce the heat to low. Simmer for 5 to 7 minutes until the edamame is thoroughly heated and tender. Check at 5 minutes.
Remove the pot from the heat. Stir in the fresh baby spinach, fresh basil leaves, fresh lemon juice, salt, and black pepper until the spinach wilts from the residual heat.
Transfer the mixture carefully to a blender, or use an immersion blender directly in the pot. Blend until the soup is velvety and completely smooth.
Divide the soup between two bowls. Garnish with the unsalted pumpkin seeds and serve immediately with the whole-grain bread on the side.
variation: Swap the pumpkin seeds for toasted slivered almonds.
conservation: Keeps 3 days refrigerated in an airtight container; reheat gently.
